purpose: live interface validation for the structured calculator schema before any registered-30 rerun

selection_rule.description: Select the first normalized development item outside the registered30 set and prior interface item with at least three arithmetic operations, then the first such item with a table aggregate operation.
notes: Gold programs are used only to assign interface strata and are never placed in prompts.
No item from the registered30 comparison set is used for this interface gate.
No sample may be substituted after registration.
